resources.string: Add a website this profile should block.

Website rules are profile-specific and apply only while this profile is active.

Rules are active as soon as they exist. Use the checkbox on each domain to enable or pause that rule without deleting it. In Block selected mode, checked domains are blocked. In Allow selected mode, checked domains are allowed.

Website blocking reads the visible URL from supported browsers through Accessibility. Supported/tested browsers include Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet, Firefox, Waterfox, Kiwi, Vivaldi, DuckDuckGo, and Ecosia. Switchly also detects Facebook Messenger’s built-in browser on a best-effort basis when Messenger exposes the current URL through Accessibility. Normal chats and message text are not treated as website surfaces. Support can still vary by app version and device. Brave Shields can temporarily hide URL information; Switchly keeps the last confirmed Brave domain while the browser remains open, but this fallback cannot guarantee perfect attribution after every navigation.
